C1166.title: API Enumeration Techniques in a Network Engineer's Theft of Gambling Site Funds
C1166.summary: A network engineer named Li Dong exploited vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and unauthorized access on a gambling website's server, database, or agent backend to steal commission funds. He exfiltrated databases and intercepted network packets to identify and filter high-commission agent accounts, ultimately replacing their bank account information to divert funds.
